Yi Li

M.S. Applied Economics & Data Science · Expected 2027

I study macroeconomics, with a focus on macro-financial linkages and monetary policies. Before Penn, I studied economics and philosophy at Boston University. This site is where I publish blog posts on interesting economic and data science analyses: what I pulled, how I cleaned it, and what it actually shows and the economic content.
